segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הוֹלֵךְ אָדָם אֵצֶל חֶנְוָנִי הָרָגִיל אֶצְלוֹ וְאוֹמֵר לוֹ: תֵּן לִי בֵּיצִים וֶאֱגוֹזִים בְּמִנְיָן, שֶׁכֵּן דֶּרֶךְ בַּעַל הַבַּיִת לִהְיוֹת מוֹנֶה בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A person» may «go» on a Festival «to a grocer» from «whom he is accustomed» to buy «and say to him: Give me eggs and nuts of» such-and-such «a number, as it is the manner of a homeowner to count» this way «in his» own «house.» Counting eggs or nuts is not considered a commercial activity, as people regularly mention the number of eggs and nuts that they need.

positions.claim: may ask for a counted number, as householders count at home
